projects.title: Matrix Reloaded (2003) — Unlinked
projects.blurb: A pacing-focused cut of *The Matrix Reloaded* that strips many Link establishment sequences plus a few early-movie wreckers (orgasm-brownie, kiss), so the story moves without the Tank-replacement hand-holding.

projects.title: Ninja Scroll (1993) — Minor Damage
projects.blurb: A leaner *Ninja Scroll* with songs from the Ninja Gaiden OST (Xbox). Reduces how women are portrayed as plot devices, removes the rape scenes, and dials back the blood — while keeping the core friendships and betrayals intact.

projects.title: Riddick (2013) — Unjinxed
projects.blurb: A dialogue-trimmed *Riddick* that keeps the Unjinxed tone, front-loads the Necromonger “wrong planet” flashback as a linear prologue, and drops the opening predator beat so the desert survival story starts clean.

projects.title: Serenity (2005) — Unjossed Edition
projects.blurb: A family/kids cut of *Serenity*: strict on Reaver gore, keeps the action and core plot, and leaves favorite Whedon beats (including “leaf on the wind” and the final fight) alone unless they break tone after horror.

projects.title: Silent Hill (2006) — Nay Tomorrow Edition
projects.blurb: A watchable *Silent Hill* cut — less gore and exposition, more room for the mystery, with Silent Hill 1 music woven in.

projects.title: Sonic (2020) — DeSchwartzed Edition
projects.blurb: A watchable *Sonic the Hedgehog* (2020) cut: trim sitcom / post-production Sonic commentary, keep the plot, and leave Jim Carrey’s Robotnik almost untouched — the film’s real reason to watch. Slogan: **Less Ben, No Predictive Programming, More Carrey!**

projects.title: Sonic 2 (2022) — DeSchwartzed Edition
projects.blurb: A watchable *Sonic the Hedgehog 2* cut: trim sitcom / post-production Sonic commentary, keep the Master Emerald plot, and leave Jim Carrey’s Robotnik — especially the mushroom-planet open — almost untouched. Slogan: **Mushroom planet. Robotnik Arrives.**

projects.title: Sonic 3 (2024) — DeSchwartzed Edition
projects.blurb: A watchable *Sonic the Hedgehog 3* cut: trim sitcom / post-production cringe that ruins pacing, keep the Shadow plot, and leave Jim Carrey’s Robotnik almost untouched — the reason this trilogy was worth anticipating. Slogan: **Seriously, this was all about Jim Carrey, not Sonic.*

projects.title: Terminator 3 (2003) — Brass Monkey Edition
projects.blurb: In Brass Monkey Edition, I attempt to cut out all distracting dialog and sequences in Terminator 3 to be more like the first two movies.
